verdict.rationale: Google Drive API docs explicitly document REST endpoints for upload (simple/multipart/resumable), list (files.list), sharing/permissions, and general CRUD operations including create/delete, with a full REST reference — clearly a documented API beyond the desktop client. Community evidence (rclone usage) corroborates real-world programmatic access to files. Missing for 10: no explicit doc citation for move/delete endpoints specifically or a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), and no independent hands-on API test citation.
